newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares rise to new high in quiet trade.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares rise to new high in quiet trade.

text.p: Swedish shares rose to new highs in quiet trade on Monday, reversing losses late last week and buoyed by gains in the U.S. and elsewhere in Europe.
The Stockholm general index rose 0.87 percent to 3,169.07 in light turnover of 738 million crowns.
"This is a typical July rally but it will be hard to hold these levels in August," said one broker.
Market heavyweights Ericsson and Astra posted gains.
Astra gained three to 155.5 crowns with brokers saying its sales report for Losec due this week was expected to be good.
The most traded shares in the morning was computer group WM Data that jumped 16 to 186 crowns.
"It is the year 2000 problem that has caused WM Data to shoot up," said one broker.
Vehicle maker Volvo rose 3.5 to 213.50 crowns with the market more optimistic about its performance in the U.S..
Bearings maker SKF was flat at 214 crowns ahead of posting its six month report on Tuesday.
